fullDescription: A centered 'Create project' form modal in cobalt→navy over a dimmed product workspace: gradient icon header, text input, a two-up template/visibility select row, a counted description textarea, and Cancel / Create project actions.
prompt:
## Resumo
A centered 'Create project' form-modal dialog floating over a dimmed, blurred product workspace (a 'Your projects' app shell with breadcrumb, search, and ghost project cards). White rounded-2xl dialog with a cobalt→navy accent rail across the top, a gradient app-icon + title/subtitle header, a vertically stacked form (text input, a two-up template/visibility select row, a character-counted description textarea), and a right-aligned Cancel / Create project footer. The whole thing sits on a brand-consistent Inter, cobalt-on-ink-neutral landing page with a sticky nav, three-up feature strip, and a dark footer.

## Estilo Visual
Build a light, modern SaaS interface using the Inter typeface (weights 400/500/600/700/800), antialiased, tight tracking on headings. Palette — neutrals (ink) ramp: 50 #f6f8fc, 100 #eef2f9, 200 #e0e6f0, 300 #c6cfde, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #070b1c. Brand (cobalt) ramp: 50 #eef3ff, 100 #dbe5fe, 200 #bfd0fe, 300 #93b0fd, 400 #5f86fa, 500 #3a62f5, 600 #2547e0, 700 #1d36c2, 800 #1c2f9c, 900 #1a2a7a, 950 #121d52. Body text ink-900 #0f172a on a white background; secondary text ink-500 #64748b / ink-600 #475569. Every primary surface uses a 135° brand gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#3a62f5 0%,#2547e0 45%,#1a2a7a 100%) with white glyphs. Borders are ink-200 #e0e6f0; form fields sit on ink-50 #f6f8fc. Shadows: soft = 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.05),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(26,42,122,.16); modal = 0 40px 80px -16px rgba(18,29,82,.42),0 0 0 1px rgba(18,29,82,.05); focus glow = 0 0 0 4px rgba(37,71,224,.14). Corner radii: lg on buttons/icon tiles, xl on inputs, 2xl on the dialog. Use Phosphor-style line/fill icons. Keep it calm, high-contrast, and uncluttered.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top header (h-16), white at 85% opacity with backdrop-blur and a bottom ink-100 border. Left: gradient diamond logo tile (h-8 w-8, rounded-lg, soft shadow) + 'Halcyon' wordmark (17px, bold). Inline nav links (Product, Templates, Pricing, Docs) in ink-600 medium that darken to ink-900 on hover, hidden on mobile. Right: a text 'Sign in' link + a gradient 'Start free' pill button (rounded-lg, white semibold, hover brightness-110). Constrain content to max-w-6xl with px-6.

### Dimmed workspace shell (modal backdrop)
Behind the modal, a real product workspace on ink-50 with a faint cobalt grid (38px) and two radial washes. Top: a breadcrumb (Workspace › Projects in ink-500/700) above an 'Your projects' h1 (text-2xl bold), with a right cluster of a bordered 'Search projects' field and a gradient '+ New project' button. Below: a responsive 1/2/3-column grid of three project cards (rounded-xl, ink-200 border, soft shadow) each with a cobalt-50 icon tile, a status pill (emerald 'Live' or ink-100 'Draft'), a title, and an 'Edited …' caption. Then cover the whole section with an absolute inset-0 overlay: bg-ink-950 at 60% + 2px backdrop blur, flex-centering the dialog.

### Modal dialog shell
Center a role=dialog aria-modal card: w-full max-w-[520px], rounded-2xl, white, shadow-modal, overflow-hidden. First child is a 1px-tall full-width accent rail filled with a horizontal cobalt→navy gradient (linear-gradient(90deg,#3a62f5,#2547e0 55%,#1a2a7a)). Sections are separated by full-width 1px ink-100 hairlines (header | body | footer).

### Dialog header
Header row (px-7 pt-6 pb-5) with a gradient rounded-xl plus-icon tile (h-9 w-9) on the left, then a title block: 'Create project' (text-lg bold, ink-900) and a one-line subtitle 'A fresh infinite canvas. Rename or restyle it anytime.' in ink-500. Far right: a ghost close (X) button, h-8 w-8 rounded-lg, ink-500 that gets an ink-100 background + ink-800 icon on hover.

### Form body
Body padded px-7 py-6 with space-y-5. (1) 'Project name' — ink-800 semibold label, full-width text input on ink-50, rounded-xl, ink-200 border, placeholder 'e.g. Aurora dashboard'. (2) A two-up grid (1 col on mobile, 2 cols ≥sm): 'Starting template' and 'Visibility', each a custom select — leading cobalt-600 icon, native select with appearance-none, trailing caret-up-down chevron in ink-500. (3) 'Description (optional)' with the word 'optional' in normal-weight ink-500 and a right-aligned tabular '0 / 280' counter; a 3-row resize-none textarea on ink-50, placeholder 'What are you designing? A line of context helps your team.' All fields share a focus state: border #2547e0, white background, and a 4px rgba(37,71,224,.14) focus ring.

### Dialog footer
Footer (px-7 py-5) right-aligned on desktop, reversed-stack full-width on mobile. Secondary 'Cancel' button: white, ink-200 border, ink-700 semibold, soft shadow, hover ink-50. Primary 'Create project' button: gradient fill, white semibold, rounded-xl, with a leading sparkle icon and hover brightness-110.

### Feature strip + footer
Below the workspace, a white section (py-16, top ink-100 border) with a three-up grid (1 col mobile / 3 cols ≥sm): each item a gradient rounded-xl icon tile (h-11 w-11) above a bold title and a relaxed ink-600 paragraph (Prompt to canvas / Branch every idea / Export clean code). Page ends in a dark footer: bg-ink-950, ink-300 text, a small gradient logo + 'Halcyon', a centered © line, and X / GitHub / YouTube icon links that brighten to white on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Centered form-modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal) with a cobalt→navy top accent rail and hairline-divided header/body/footer

### Componente
Navy 60% scrim with 2px backdrop blur over a fully-rendered product workspace (not an empty gray overlay)

### Componente
Custom select control: leading brand icon + appearance-none native select + trailing caret-up-down chevron, on an ink-50 fill

### Componente
Two-up responsive field row (template + visibility) that stacks to one column on mobile

### Componente
Description textarea with an inline live character counter (tabular-nums '0 / 280') in the label row

### Componente
Shared field focus treatment: cobalt border + 4px translucent cobalt focus ring + background goes white

### Componente
Gradient primary buttons (135° cobalt→navy) with leading Phosphor icons; ghost secondary buttons with soft shadow

### Componente
Project cards with cobalt-50 icon tiles and emerald/ink status pills

## Notas Especiais
Single brand gradient (135deg #3a62f5→#2547e0→#1a2a7a) is reused on EVERY primary surface — keep it consistent. The modal must float over a real, populated workspace that is dimmed, not a blank backdrop; that contrast is what sells the focus. Mobile reflow: dialog overlay switches from center-aligned to top-aligned (items-start, py-16), the template/visibility row collapses to one column, and footer buttons go full-width in reverse order (primary on top). Inter only, no em-dashes anywhere in copy.
